basic_details.job_title: RDSO Senior Section Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 42 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Research Designs and Standards Organisation (RDSO) has notified 42 contractual vacancies for Sr. Section Engineer/Inspection/Electrical (25) and Sr. Section Engineer/Inspection/Mech (17) posts. Eligible candidates can apply through email or post on or before 9 November 2026. Applicants must be Sr. Section Engineers in Pay Level-7 with a minimum of 5 years of experience, while a Degree or Diploma is preferred. The pay is specified as Pay Level-7 for both posts, with a 4-year tenure that is extendable or curtailable. Selection involves screening by a committee based on APAR and educational quali

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must reach through proper channel to the Director General, RDSO, Manak Nagar, Lucknow-226011 on or before 09.11.2026 by e-mail or Post etc. The official email address for application submission is [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Eligibility Conditions: Sr. Section Engineer (Cadre Post) Pay Level-7 working in the concerned department (Electrical or Mechanical) of Zonal Railway/Production Unit. Minimum 05 years of Service Experience as Sr. Section Engineer (Cadre Post) Pay Level-7 is necessary. Total APAR Grading of last three years (22-23, 23-24 and 24-25) should not be less than 11 marks and Grading of APAR of last year should not be less than 'GOOD'. Candidate must have minimum 05 years' residual service. Medical Category: B-1 is required. Cooling-off period of three years will be maintained between two tenures in RDSO. Candidates against whom any penalty was imposed as outcome of vigilance case during the previous RDSO tenure will be debarred. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Attested photocopies of Service Book (each page attested) APARs of the applicants for the last three years (2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25) NO D&AR and SPE/Vig. clearance status

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on the screening of eligible candidates by a Screening Committee. Screening will be conducted based on prescribed marks for two items: APAR of last 03 years (Maximum Marks: 15) and Educational/Professional Qualifications (Maximum Marks: 05). After screening, a panel and a merit list corresponding to the vacancies will be prepared.

faq.question: Q1. Is the RDSO Sr. Section Engineer post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be posted in the concerned department for 04 years on a tenure basis which can be extended or curtailed as per administrative requirements, and the post is ex-cadre with eligibility for further promotion in their parent cadre only.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for age or other relaxations, and how much is granted?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limit or age relaxations, but stipulates that experience in ex-cadre posts and pay level granted due to MACP will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. How are candidates shortlisted for the vacancies?
faq.answer: Selection is conducted by a Screening Committee based on prescribed marks for the APAR of the last 03 years and educational qualifications, without a written examination.

faq.question: Q4. Who cannot apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates with pending or contemplated D&AR and SPE/Vigilance cases, those who have not completed the required cooling-off period of three years, or those against whom any penalty was imposed as an outcome of a vigilance case during a previous RDSO tenure are debarred.

faq.question: Q5. Which documents must be sent along with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must send attested photocopies of their Service Book, APARs for the last three years (2022-23, 2023-24, and 2024-25), and a clear D&AR and Vigilance clearance through proper channel.
